title: Gibson Plugin Manifest
description: Schema for plugin.gibson.zeroroot.ai/v1 plugin manifests. Use a YAML editor with yaml-language-server support to get autocomplete: # yaml-language-server: $schema=schema.json

kind.description: Must be 'Plugin'. Maps to gibson.identity.v1.PrincipalKind.PRINCIPAL_KIND_PLUGIN. Sister schemas exist for 'Agent' and 'Tool' manifests.

name.description: DNS-label-style identifier for the plugin. Must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9]$.

version.description: Semantic version of the plugin (e.g. '1.2.3' or '0.1.0-alpha').

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the plugin.

author.description: Optional identifier for the plugin's author.

workload_class.description: Must be 'plugin'. Tool and agent manifests are out of scope for this schema.

secrets.description: Declared credential needs. May be empty when the plugin requires no credentials.

methods.description: RPC methods this plugin implements. Must contain at least one entry unless dynamic_methods is true.

dynamic_methods.description: When true, the plugin discovers some or all of its methods at startup via a method source (plugin.WithMethodSource); spec.methods may then be empty.

runtime.description: Execution environment. Defaults to 'process' when omitted. 'process' is local-dev only; 'pod' (default deploy) and 'setec' (hardened) are the deployed runtimes (ADR-0065 R5).

egress.description: Declared external network targets. Informational in process/pod modes; enforced in setec mode.

scope.description: When the secret is resolved: 'startup' (once at start) or 'per_call' (each invocation).

rotation.description: How the plugin reacts to a rotation event: 'live' (cache invalidation) or 'restart' (exit 75).

required.description: When true, missing secret blocks plugin startup.

MethodDecl.description: A single method declaration. Under the Go-first authoring model (ADR-0065 R4) the request/response contract is derived by the SDK from the typed Go structs registered with plugin.WithHandler and is not declared here.

name.description: Method identifier. Non-empty. Must match a handler registered via plugin.WithHandler.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the method, surfaced in the component catalog.

ManifestPolicy.description: Security policy overrides for this plugin.

setec_required.description: When true, the plugin refuses to start unless the runtime is 'setec'.

startup_timeout.description: Maximum duration before the startup probe fails. Go duration string (e.g. '30s'). Defaults to '30s'.

liveness_interval.description: Interval at which the liveness probe is polled. Go duration string (e.g. '10s'). Defaults to '10s'.

EgressDecl.description: A single external network target the plugin contacts.

host.description: DNS name or wildcard pattern (e.g. '*.example.com'). IP addresses are not permitted.

port.description: Destination port number. Must be in [1, 65535].

purpose.description: Optional human-readable description of why this egress target is needed.
